::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 23rd 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge XV 1
:::

Dear [Mr Furnivall](people/person_531.qmd)
I am afraid I cannot now read the books mentioned, as they have drifted out of my reach and I have much less time than I had in the old times when it was undertaken[^1]

Yours truly
C.M. Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY and her mother had been recruited by Furnivall among the readers collecting quotations for the [project](organizations/other_151.qmd) which was to become the *New English Dictionary*.
